title: A Picture of an Adventure
lines: Hana likes to draw best of all.
She made a picture of a big adventure.
In it she rode a green dragon.
It took her all day to get it right.
She hung the picture next to her bed.
In the night the picture fell down.
The cat had made a mess of it.
There was a long rip in the sky.
Hana felt sad. She got some tape.
But the tape did not stick at all.
Then Hana had a much better plan.
She cut a patch and drew a rock.
Now the green dragon stands on that rock.
Hana likes the picture better than at first.

questions.listenFor: A big adventure - she rode a green dragon. Lines two and three go together.

questions.ask: What did Hana try first, and did it work?
questions.listenFor: Tape. It did not stick at all, so she cut a patch instead.

questions.ask: What adventure would you draw? Why?
questions.listenFor: Any answer is fine. This one is worth drawing after.
